title: A Bilevel Market Equilibrium Model for Natural Gas Pipeline Network Operations: Convex Relaxations and Single-level Reformulations
summary: We propose an integrated market equilibrium model for determining the spot market prices and flow rates in a natural gas pipeline network. The traditional approach solves the market equilibrium model separately from the natural gas network flow allocation problem in a sequential manner. Our proposed framework synthesizes marketing and operations by using a bilevel optimization formulation where the market equilibrium model in the upper level is connected and simultaneously solved with the natural gas network flow model in the lower level.
